API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIIntermediate CA CertificatesUpdate SSL Exempted Urls
Update SSL Exempted Urls
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/sslSettings/exemptedUrls
DEPRECATED

This endpoint has been deprecated and may be replaced or removed in future versions of the API.

Adds URLs to the exempted from SSL Inspection and policy evaluation list or removes URLs from the list. To add a URL to the list, set the action parameter to ADD_TO_LIST. To remove a URL, set action to REMOVE_FROM_LIST.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
action
string
REQUIRED

Possible values: [ADD_TO_LIST, REMOVE_FROM_LIST]

The action applied to the exempted URLs list (i.e., adding a URL or removing a URL).

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
urls
string[]

Domains or URLs which are exempted from SSL Inspection
